module: Nutanix Cryptographic Module for OpenSSH Server
caveat: When operated in FIPS mode and configured as specified in Section 3 of the Security Policy with the Nutanix Cryptographic Module for OpenSSL validated to FIPS 140-2 under Cert. #4249 operating in FIPS mode. No assurance of the minimum strength of generated keys
description: The Nutanix Cryptographic Module for OpenSSH Server is a cryptographic software module, designated as a multi-chip standalone embodiment, and used in Nutanix solutions to provide FIPS 140-2 Approved SSH server-side secure communication.
tested_configurations: CentOS 7.9 on Nutanix Acropolis Hypervisor (AHV) 7.1.1 running on a Nutanix NX-3360-G7 with an Intel® Xeon® Gold 6234 with PAA
